metadata.title: Volume asymptotics for a family of hyperbolic 3-manifolds with totally geodesic boundary
metadata.abstract: For the family $\{\mathcal{M}_{g,k}\}_{g\geqslant k\geqslant 0}$ of orientable hyperbolic 3-manifolds with totally geodesic boundary and cusps introduced by R.~Frigerio, B.~Martelli, and C.~Petronio, the volume of the manifolds depends only on the non-negative integer parameters $g$ and $k$; thus the volume function $Vol(g,k)$ is well defined. The main result of the paper is an asymptotic description of this function: it is approximated by a linear function of $g$ and $k$ whose coefficients are explicitly expressed in terms of the volumes of the regular ideal tetrahedron and the regular ideal octahedron; moreover, the volume does not exceed the linear approximation by a difference of order $O(1/g)$. As consequences, three theorems comparing volumes are obtained: monotonicity under coordinatewise increase of the parameters, estimates for the passage from parameter $g$ to $g+1$, and monotonicity along lines of constant complexity $g+k$. For small values of the parameters, approximate values of the volumes are computed and collected in a table used in verifying the cases $g<8$.
metadata.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Wolfram Mathematica 14 was used for numerical computations; the verification scripts are included in Appendices A and B
